name: falcon-snort-bi-all-mpnet-base-v2
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from sentence-transformers/all-mpnet-base-v2 (config.json max_position_embeddings 514). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (MPNet), full attention, no causal mask, relative position bias
notes: ADDED 2026-11-01. Symmetric InfoNCE contrastive finetune of sentence-transformers/all-mpnet-base-v2 mapping cyber-threat-intelligence text and SNORT rules into one embedding space. Same-table base comparison on the repo's own SNORT/CTI test split: the card's 'pretrained' row is the untrained mpnet backbone measured with the same harness, 0.8142 recall@1 and 0.3063 F1, against 0.9551 and 0.9443 for the shipped checkpoint. THE RELEASED CHECKPOINT IS run_4, not run_0: the card ships five runs and the repo's final commit message reads 'FALCON best checkpoint - best run r4 (test_f1=0.9443)', so r4's numbers are the ones recorded - run_0 was the earlier best-by-val-loss commit. All five runs land within 0.003 recall@1 of each other, so the choice barely moves the headline. The gain is large because the base has no notion of SNORT syntax. Private domain benchmark, not BEIR or MTEB, so not comparable to nDCG@10 rows elsewhere. Licence cc-by-nc-nd-4.0 - non-commercial, no derivatives - repo created 2026-05-28.
